question: What Is Your Honest Opinion Of The USA?

answers.text: It is a place burdened by the prioritization of liberty in a way that is good, in a way that is bad. There's a lot of freedom here, and I think that allows people to be the best of themselves and the worst of themselves.
A little disappointed.
It's a weird place to be.

I don't think they're very popular. I don't think that this is what people really want,
but I think at the end of the day, I think most Americans want to see others do well.

You know, history, you know, there's always periods of division and whatnot. So I think people will be fine. And I think that ultimately Americans still have respect for each other, which is a good thing.
